correctness.rationale: For lambda(t)=A/(t+a)+B/(t+b) the exact derivative of the apparent elasticity E=-t lambda’/lambda decomposes into two positive component saturation terms and a negative mixture-weight-change term. Minimizing the positive terms relative to pi(1-pi) gives a single quadratic y^2-(r-1)y+r<0, with r=sqrt(b/a), hence the sharp threshold b/a>(3+2sqrt2)^2=17+12sqrt2. At critical contrast the only stationary contact is horizontal and not a reversal; above contrast choosing A/B=sqrt(a/b) makes E’ negative at t=sqrt(ab) but positive near both endpoints. Exact symbolic differentiation independently reproduced all five coefficients of the quartic numerator, which has at most two positive zeros by Descartes’ rule, and the exact witness E’(10)=-41/4840 for a=1,b=100,A=1/10,B=1. Finite symbolic checks supplement the all-positive-parameter analytic proof.
